about: Script for the scripted SDK (app/backend/dev/scripted-sdk.ts) over the ext fixture: questions and plans asked in another Claude Code process (R6.8). Made up. e1e1 and e2e2 have no script: their transcripts end on an AskUserQuestion (two questions, one multi-select) and an ExitPlanMode with no result, so they read needs you with a read-only card. e3e3 ends on a question too, but Synopia's own process ended after it (stored), so it reads Not answered (Synopia quit). Run: app/web/dev/cdp/run.sh extcard, which shifts the times so the cards are 4 min old.
